product: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 Public (COP-DEM_GLO-30-DGED, AWS Open Data COG distribution)
rule: 1-degree cells holding emerged-band cells (D-071 band, extents_v6_250m.npz), less N44E048 and N44E049 (D-073)
vertical_datum: EGM2008 (EPSG 3855), NGA undulations w.r.t. WGS 84 (Product Handbook v5.0 §1.2.1)
auxiliary_layers: EDM, FLM, WBM (AUXFILES) are in the AWS distribution; HEM is not downloaded
